issues.detail: The Greek verb 'εσομαι' (esōmai) is the future tense of 'eimi' (to be). The Vietnamese translation 'sẽ tin cậy' (will trust/rely) uses a compound verb structure that implies an action of trusting, whereas the Greek 'εσομαι πεποιθως' literally means 'I will be persuaded/convinced.' However, more importantly, the Greek 'πεποιθως' is a perfect passive participle, indicating a state of being convinced. The Vietnamese 'tin cậy' (trust) is a standard active verb that slightly shifts the nuance from a state of conviction to an act of trust.
